critical_code_review_comments: withdraw.py _compute_withdrawable correctly uses STRICT `$gt` against last_withdrawn_period — guarantees no double-spend across consecutive FIFO withdraws. Match also requires period to exist & not be null which is safer than `$gt` alone.

mark_paid flips lines via chunked _id-paginated update_many on db_bg (CSOT-uncapped) — this is the correct pattern for the 1M+-row production scenario per the iteration_23 context. Chunk size 5000 is sensible.

labels.last_withdrawn_period is bumped to period_to ONLY inside mark_paid (post-payment) — request and approve don't advance it. Reject correctly refunds balance without touching last_withdrawn_period. Reject path verified by code reading + RBAC test.
revenue_rollup.rollup_revenue_by_id requires match_status in ['matched','manually_matched'] — prevents revenue inflation from unmatched lines. Good defensive default.
Both admin and label list endpoints use the SAME helper — keeps logic single-source-of-truth.

/api/withdraw/label/request no longer takes a body (FastAPI infers empty body since there's no Body param) — verified that POSTing with `{}` body returns non-422. Backwards-incompatible API change for any caller still sending amount_idr, but acceptable since spec explicitly mandated force-full.
Frontend Withdraw.jsx correctly hides the FIFO form when (a) bank not verified or (b) window closed, replacing it with an 'Input Rekening' or 'Buka kembali tanggal 1' empty-state. UX is clear.
Frontend /admin/artists & /admin/releases period filters are <select> dropdowns (Semua + specific months) rather than free-text YYYY-MM inputs — robust against typos. Both query re-fire on change.
